ci_diagnostic_analysis.distinction: Byte hash passes 100%. Owner (O:BA), Group, and all ordered ACEs are 100% identical. The sole difference was the D:AI vs D: auto-inherited DACL control-bit flag (SE_DACL_AUTO_INHERITED), which Windows assigns upon setting security descriptors when all ACEs carry the ID (inherited) flag on an unprotected descriptor. This was not an owner-assignment exception.

security_preserving_correction.setup_ps1: Implemented Test-SddlEquivalence to compare descriptors. Normalizes only the auto-inherited control bit (AI) on unprotected DACLs when all permissions are identical. Removed speculative try/catch fallback in Set-FileAclSddl.
